faqs.question: What is TAMYIZ™?
faqs.answer: TAMYIZ™ is a digital publishing platform founded by Sahil Naseer and Basit Majeed in Sopore, Kashmir, offering DRM-free PDF e-books across practical AI/security/business guides and literary fiction. You can read more in the About us and How we write pages in the menu.

faqs.question: Are there any bundle discounts?
faqs.answer: Yes! TAMYIZ™ applies automatic bundle discounts at Checkout: **20% off** when buying 2 books, and **25% off** when buying 3 or more books (applied automatically before any promo coupon).

faqs.question: How do I download my e-book after paying?
faqs.answer: TAMYIZ™ e-books are DRM-free PDFs sold securely via Razorpay (UPI, cards, net banking, wallets). Right after payment, your private signed download link appears immediately on screen AND is emailed to you via receipt (valid for 1 year, up to 10 downloads per link). Reads on phones, tablets, laptops, Kindle (Send to Kindle), and Apple Books.

faqs.question: How do I recover a lost download link?
faqs.answer: If you lost your file, open the Download Recovery page from the footer and enter your order email or 10-digit phone number to have your download links re-sent to your order email. If you reached the 10-download limit, message us on WhatsApp at +91 95417 22379 or email tamyiz.co@gmail.com with your Razorpay payment ID.

faqs.question: Can I read a free sample first?
faqs.answer: Yes! Open any book from the E-books page and click "Read Free Sample (Chapter 1)" (or expand the on-page preview) to read Chapter 1 and browse the full chapter list before buying.

faqs.question: What is your refund policy?
faqs.answer: Because digital PDFs are delivered immediately, refunds are offered within 7 days for a double charge or a file we could not deliver or fix (processed back to your account in 5–7 working days). You can read the full Refund & Cancellation Policy in the footer.

faqs.question: How do pre-orders and gift orders work?
faqs.answer: Editions marked 'Coming Soon' can be pre-ordered on WhatsApp (+91 95417 22379). Promo coupons are also supported at Checkout.

faqs.question: How do I contact TAMYIZ™ support?
faqs.answer: You can email tamyiz.co@gmail.com, message WhatsApp at +91 95417 22379, or open Contact Us in the footer.
